decisions.rationale: The private comparison shows different people and different capture scenes; low dHash distance is a false positive. This is not expert label review.
The private comparison shows the same person, pose, clothing and background with a small crop/encoding difference across train and valid. This is source-identity review, not lesion-label review.
The private comparison shows the same source photo/person across train and valid, with crop and watermark differences. This is source-identity review, not lesion-label review.
The private comparison independently confirms the already reviewed train/valid crop and watermark variants are the same source photo/person. This is source-identity review, not lesion-label review.
The private comparison shows the same person, clothing and studio background in distinct train/valid poses. This is person-identity review, not lesion-label review.
The private comparison shows the same person and studio series in distinct train/valid poses. This is person-identity review, not lesion-label review.
The private comparison shows the same person, clothing and background in distinct train/valid poses. This is person-identity review, not lesion-label review.
The private comparison independently confirms the already reviewed train/valid crop and encoding variants are the same source photo/person. This is source-identity review, not lesion-label review.
